name: Azure Key Vault
description: Azure Key Vault integration with Drupal.
project_description: Azure Key Vault integrates a subset of the Azure Key Vault REST API with Drupal, authenticating with an Azure Active Directory (AAD) OAuth2 client-credentials token. It exposes a single injectable service (azure_key_vault.http_client / AzureKeyVaultRequestHandler) whose methods create, read, list, delete and purge secrets and create, read, encrypt, decrypt and delete RSA keys in a configured vault. Connection settings (vault URL, AAD token URL, client id, client-secret Key reference and API version) are managed on an admin form. The optional azure_key_vault_key_provider submodule wires the service into the Key module as a KeyProvider plus an 'Azure Encryption' KeyType, so secrets and RSA keys can be managed through the Key module's UI.
